explain.en: Models downloaded in the Ollama app or with `ollama pull`. Models you built yourself with `ollama create` may be your only copy, so Hoardless only shows the size. Remove models one by one with Ollama's own command.
explain.zh: 在 Ollama 里下载的模型（App 里点的或用 `ollama pull` 拉的）。你自己用 `ollama create` 做的模型可能只有这一份，所以这里只显示大小。要删请用 Ollama 自带的命令逐个删除。

notes: The macOS app's model-location setting lives in ~/Library/Application Support/Ollama/db.sqlite (settings.models) and overrides OLLAMA_MODELS (app/server/server.go); a fixed path misses it, needs a resolver. Never target ~/.ollama as a whole: it holds id_ed25519 (auth key). Not installed on the maintainer's Mac, so no local observation.
